versions.changelog:
tiktok-performance-review v1.0.0

- Initial release providing structured access to real-time TikTok content data.
- Supports keyword search (with sorting/filtering), batch creator post retrieval (by profile link/username), and video comment extraction (by video link/ID).
- Outputs consistent, structured JSON for use in content analysis, creator tracking, and social listening.
- Includes clear command-line examples, parameter rules, and routing based on user intent for TikTok.
- Enforces strict execution and output conventions for robust integration and automation.
